title: The degreewise pullback tensor comparison is a map of complexes
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], $f\colon X\to Y$ a morphism of schemes and $f^*\colon\Mod_{\Lambda_Y}\to\Mod_{\Lambda_X}$ the pullback of module objects [def-sfb-module-upper-star] with its monoidal comparison $\mu_{M,N}\colon f^*M\otimes f^*N\to f^*(M\otimes N)$ for the relative tensor products [def-sfb-modobj-relative-tensor]. For cochain complexes $A,B$ of $\Lambda_Y$-modules with signed total tensor complex $A\otimes B$ [def-sfb-preserves-kflat-quasi-iso], let $c^n\colon\bigoplus_{p+q=n}f^*A^p\otimes f^*B^q\to f^*\bigl((A\otimes B)^n\bigr)$ be the map whose $(p,q)$ component is $f^*(\iota_{p,q})\circ\mu_{A^p,B^q}$, where $\iota_{p,q}\colon A^p\otimes B^q\to(A\otimes B)^n$ is the inclusion. Then $d^n_{f^*(A\otimes B)}\circ c^n=c^{n+1}\circ d^n_{f^*A\otimes f^*B}$ for every $n\in\mathbf Z$.

proof.text: Apply the already constructed strong monoidal comparison on cochain complexes to the additive, coproduct-preserving strong monoidal module pullback F. For each degree n, the coproduct summand formula for (F.mapCochainComplexμIso A B).hom.f n is exactly the defining formula for upperStarTensorComplexHomX: on (p,q) with p+q=n it is the ordinary tensorator followed by F of the summand inclusion. Coproduct extensionality identifies the maps in each degree. Substitute these identifications in the chain-map equation of the hom component of the isomorphism. This gives precisely the required equation for n,n′, including every relation in ComplexShape.up ℤ.

lemma upperStarTensorComplexHom_comm
    (A B : CochainComplex
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ Y)) ℤ) (n n' : ℤ)
    (_ : (ComplexShape.up ℤ).Rel n n') :
    upperStarTensorComplexHomX Λ f A B n ≫
        (((f)^*⟦Λ⟧.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (A ⊗ B)).d n n' =
      (((f)^*⟦Λ⟧.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj A ⊗
        ((f)^*⟦Λ⟧.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj B).d n n' ≫
        upperStarTensorComplexHomX Λ f A B n' := by
  have hc := HomologicalComplex.Hom.comm
    (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorComparison (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δNatTrans (f)^*⟦Λ⟧)
      (.up ℤ) A B) n n'
  have hX := upperStarTensorComplexHomX_comp_mapBifunctorComparisonX Λ f A B
  simp only [Functor.OplaxMonoidal.mapHomologicalComplexδNatTrans_app_app] at hX
  rw [← cancel_mono ((HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorComparison
      (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δNatTrans (f)^*⟦Λ⟧) (.up ℤ) A B).f n'), Category.assoc,
    Category.assoc,
    hX, Category.comp_id]
  exact (congrArg (upperStarTensorComplexHomX Λ f A B n ≫ ·) hc).symm.trans
    ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans ((congrArg (· ≫ _) (hX n)).trans (Category.id_comp _)))

No new nodes, which is right for a four-line calculation. lem-sfb-termwise-strong-monoidal is a stronger result with extra coproduct hypotheses and is correctly not used. The module-level monoidal_upperStar has no owning DAG node; its pieces are def-sfb-mapmod-strong-monoidal and lem-sfb-internal-extension-monoidal. This is inherited from the base, and the proof uses only naturality, which every monoidal comparison has by definition.
